exclusions.what: All eyes and both baseline-acuity subgroups, VA (ETDRS letters) at baseline, 1 year and 2 years and changes (Table 1, tab1!R3-R5, C2-C6)
exclusions.reason: Complete-case set (protocol inclusion 5): the inclusion criterion is a follow-up of at least 2 years, equal to the last tabulated visit, and 123 of 303 treated eyes were included; the statement that no patient was lost to follow-up follows from this criterion and does not state that no treated eye was left out.

Post-baseline selection: the exclusion criteria remove, from every visit, eyes that received laser or steroid treatment or cataract surgery during the follow-up period (protocol inclusion 5; such analysis sets get no record).

exclusions.what: Proportions of eyes gaining or losing letters (Table 2, tab2)

notes: Best-corrected acuity established: the Methods state that best-corrected VA was recorded as ETDRS letters on an ETDRS chart.
Prior treatment mixed (prior macular laser in part of the eyes); some eyes were switched between ranibizumab and aflibercept during the two years.
Central retinal subfield thickness (Table 3) and injection numbers are not extracted.
